description: Implementation of P256 elliptic curve key exchange for QUIC protocol, including key generation, shared key calculation, and public key retrieval.

classes.name: P256KeyExchange
classes.description: Handles elliptic curve key exchange operations using P256 curve for QUIC.

methods.name: P256KeyExchange::New
methods.description: Creates a new P256KeyExchange instance with a generated private key.

methods.name: P256KeyExchange::NewPrivateKey
methods.description: Generates a new private key for P256 curve and returns it as a string.

methods.name: P256KeyExchange::public_value
methods.description: Returns the public key as a string view.

methods.name: P256KeyExchange::CalculateSharedKeySync
methods.description: Calculates the shared ECDH key with a peer's public value.
